editorialSummary: As [COP31 climate talks collapse](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-28/chris-bowen-cop-climate-politics/107434496) and the US Air Force [cloud platform gets hacked](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/27/us-air-force-cloud-platform-hacked-reuters-reports?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss), our collective survival instincts remain impressively dormant. Thankfully, researchers just discovered the [faintest supernova ever](https://www.timesofisrael.com/stellar-discovery-israeli-researchers-may-have-found-faintest-supernova-ever-recorded/), providing a fittingly dim light to guide us through our own self-inflicted twilight.
